goal: Build a SMALL source-driven routes.json plugin. Steps: code-map {}; export-snapshot include ["routes.json"]; read-source by sourceId; import-conventions notes/sourceIds. Read output and case schemas once. Call get-capabilities schema=identity, kind=route, slots={scopeId:repo.repo.main,routerId:app,mode:history,declaredPath:/orders} to obtain the EXACT expected route ID for the case; never guess a hash. Generate a Node script under 120 lines that JSON.parse each current input source and emits route entities from current routes plus actual UTF-8 evidence, with no fixed output facts. Use includeIdentityHelper=true, list identity.mjs in manifest.artifacts, import computeEntityId/computeEvidenceId. Include ALL manifest, script, case and case input files in write-candidate. ONE case must require the /orders ID just computed; use exported CollectorInput as fixture with stageId=extract. No file entities or relations. files is an actual JSON array of path/content objects, never an encoded string. Then validate-plugin and stop after activation.

investigation.notes:
Route registry convention (project live-project, scope repo.repo.main):

1. DECLARED source of routing: a single JSON config file `routes.json` at repository root (repo.main), emitted by Core as sourceClass=config, object with keys routerId, mode, routes[]; verified in current snapshot content ed7c0838...f102 (src_b2dd36..., 124 bytes, CRLF terminated).
   - {"routerId":"app","mode":"history","routes":[{"path":"/orders","name":"Orders"},{"path":"/inventory","name":"Inventory"}]}
2. Identity slots confirmed for route entities via Core identity schema (kind=route): scopeId, routerId, mode, declaredPath. Canonical order/shape taken from the returned identity array; scopeId uses "<repositoryId>-scoped" project form observed in status coverage (repo.repo.main).
3. Observed route entries: /orders (name Orders) -> Core-computed entityId ent_d023c5b7b1847d6433677bfab770467189c7f74667609124f1f89523aff31a3f for slots {scopeId:repo.repo.main,routerId:app,mode:history,declaredPath:/orders}. /inventory is a second current entry with the same routerId/mode.
4. Evidence rule: byte offsets must be computed per input snapshot. lineMap from read-source shows line starts [0,124] i.e. one JSON line plus trailing CRLF, so startLine/endLine = 1 for every route; valueStart/valueEnd locate the exact path string inside that line; relPath used to pick the matching evidence range (line 1, whole-file byte range 0..124).
5. No AST/framework inference needed: this project declares routes as data, not code. Basis = declared, origin = static.
6. GAPS / not invented: no alias registry, menu mapping, i18n title source, lazy component import or HTTP endpoint binding was found in the snapshot (code-map returned zero files/symbols besides this config), so no route->component or route->endpoint relations are emitted. Router registration mechanism (vue-router/react-router/etc.) is NOT confirmed by any source and must not be assumed.
7. Required fields: an entry lacking a non-empty string "path" cannot form a complete route identity -> emit gap (code route.identity.incomplete) instead of guessing a path. Malformed/absent JSON -> coverage failed + gap routes.source.unreadable.
8. Plugin outputs route entities only; no file entities and no relations (per task scope and lack of confirmed bindings).
